messages:
anya: Quick idea  Sunday brunch + boardgames at the office kitchen this Sunday 11:00 AM? Short session (2 hours) so people can still enjoy the afternoon. Pancakes + coffee + casual games. React with emoji: :pancakes: = I can make pancakes, :coffee: = Ill bring coffee, :game_die: = Ill bring a game.
liam: Ooh yes. I can do pancakes (blueberry). :pancakes: :yum:
sofia: In! I can bring espresso and some oat milk. :coffee:
pierre: Im in for games  bringing Azul or 7 Wonders Duel (whichever fits the table). :game_die: :game_die:
jane: Ill stop by for the last hour  can't do full two hours but will swing by around noon. Also bringing some fruit.
anya: Awesome  looks like we have pancake + coffee covered and games. If anyone wants to bring a snack or vegetarian option, add a note. Also we have limited table space so smaller box games preferred.
sofia: Noted re: table space. Ill bring a small folding table for extra surface.
liam: Can someone bring an extra set of utensils and plates? I have disposables but could use forks.
jane: I have reusable plates in my desk  bringing them.
pierre: Quick poll: prefer 11:00 start or 11:30? React :one: for 11:00, :two: for 11:30.
liam: :one:
sofia: :one:
jane: :two: (will be a bit late either way)
anya: 11:00 wins. I'll post a quick Zoom link for remote folks to pop in and watch the pancake flipping (optional).
calendar-bot: Event created: "Sunday Boardgame Brunch"  Sun Jul 16  11:00 AM  Office Kitchen  RSVP: https://calendar.example.com/event/brunch176 (auto-reminder 6 hours prior)
sofia: Also: any strong allergies we should label on dishes?
liam: No severe allergies in my case. Ill label blueberry pancake batter (contains eggs + dairy).
jane: Nut allergy here  thanks for the heads up, label anything with nuts.
anya: Will do  label dishes. If it rains or we need more space, fallback to Conference Room B; I'll post final confirmation Sat 6pm.
pierre: Bringing Azul. If you'd rather a 4-player, I can also bring a filler like Sushi Go.
sofia: Perfect mix. See you Sunday  or on Zoom for pancake theatre. :grinning_face_with_big_eyes:
